title: ROOM– 24/7 Total Surveillance
description:
A secret observation diary of the rookie announcer Hiiragi Yume's private life.

"I'm gonna capture every bit of her life through this lens..."

The protagonist Shinya works as a landlord at a condominium he inherited from his parents.

Suddenly, a new graduate moves in from outside of Tokyo.

Her name: Hiiragi Yume.

She's an up-and-coming TV anchor, nice to everyone, with a charming, down to earth personality.

Her parents chose your condominium, thinking it would be safe.

But little did they know, it was actually a glass house where the landlord watches over everyone.

Using a spare key, he breaks into her unit and installs hidden cameras everywhere.

You will spy on her personal life, blackmail her, and slowly rewrite her own life.

[Gameplay: Infiltration and Surveillance]

Infiltration:

Take advantage of her absence to search her room. Find more places to install cameras and eliminate blind spots.

Scheduling: 

Create a weekly plan. Study to improve your observational skills, and craft to create more cameras.

Special Tools: 

Obtain items like sleeping pills and aphrodisiacs to make her even more vulnerable to you, triggering special events.

[Sex System]

Multiple Endings:

Will you blackmail her with your footage and completely dominate her?

Or will you hide your desires and have her fall in love with you?

It all depends on your own actions.

Interactive Sex: 

Switch camera angles while having sex, choose between ejaculating inside and out. Her reactions will change depending on your actions.

Varied Situations:

Standing doggy style against a mirror, sex from behind while in a call,

forced cowgirl as you watch herself on TV,

bondage, deepthroating, sex toys,

and even loving, intimate sex, as well as a morning blowjob.

[Characters]

■ Hiiragi Yume (age: 22)

An up-and-coming news anchor.

Having just moved to the city to chase her dreams, she is ignorant of the many dangers of urban living.

She seems to be utterly convinced that the landlord is a nice person,

but will your own machinations cause her smile to fade...?

Game ContentPlaytime: Approximately 6~8 hours for a leisurely pace

Visual Contents

Animated HCGs: 30 types, each realistic thrusting motions and varied facial expressions.

Meticulous CGs: Over 20 high quality original illustrations created meticulously for each scenario.
